ii < static_cast<long long>(rowEnd); ++ii) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(ii);\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[(i - rowBegin) * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Tiled, register-blocked matrix multiply: C[rows x N] = A[rows x N] * B[N x N]\n// Each C element accumulates over k in increasing order, matching the sequential reference\n__global__ void matmulKernel(const double* __restrict__ A, const double* __restrict__ B,\n                             double* __restrict__ C, const size_t rows, const size_t N) {\n    __shared__ double As[BK][BM + 1]; B[(k0 + k) * N + col] : 0.0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        for (int k = 0; k < kLen; ++k) {\n            double a[TM];\n            double b[TN];\n            for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++j) {\n                    acc[i][j] += a[i] * b[j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < TM; ++i) {\n        const size_t row = rowBase + threadIdx.y * TM + i;\n        if (row >= rows) continue;\n        for (int j = 0; j < TN; ++j) {\n            const size_t col = colBase + threadIdx.x * TN + j;\n            if (col < N) C[row * N + col] = acc[i][j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Compute rows [0, rows) of C on one GPU\nvoid computeOnDevice(const int device, const double* A, const double* B, double* C,\n                     const size_t N, const size_t rows) {\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));\n\n    const size_t aBytes = rows * N * sizeof(double);\n    const size_t bBytes = N * N * sizeof(double);\n\n    double *dA = nullptr, *dB = nullptr, *dC = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dA, aBytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, bBytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dC, aBytes));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dA, A, aBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B, bBytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const dim3 block(BLOCK_DIM, BLOCK_DIM);\n    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned>((N + BN - 1) / BN),\n                    static_cast<unsigned>((rows + BM - 1) / BM));\n    matmulKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dA, dB, dC, rows, N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(C, dC, aBytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dA));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dB));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dC));\n}\n\n// Split this rank's rows across its GPUs, one OpenMP thread driving each GPU\nvoid computeLocalRows(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                      std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N, const size_t rows,\n                      const std::vector<int>& devices) {\n    if (rows == 0 || N == 0) return;\n\n    const int numDevices = static_cast<int>(std::min(devices.size(), rows));\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static, 1) num_threads(numDevices)\n    for (int t = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n\n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, OpenMP threads per rank: %d\\n\", size, omp_get_max_threads());\n    }\n\n    // Bind each rank to GPUs on its node\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    int localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n\n    const std::vector<int> devices = selectDevices(localRank, localSize);\n    for (int d : devices) {\n        // Create the CUDA context up front so it stays out of the timed region\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(d));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));\n    }\n\n    // This rank's block of rows of A and C\n    const size_t rowBegin = partBegin(rank, size, N);\n    const size_t rowEnd = partBegin(rank + 1, size, N);\n    const size_t rows = rowEnd - rowBegin;\n\n    // Allocate matrices\n    const bool needFullC = printResults || validate;\n    std::vector<double> A(rows * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C((root && needFullC) ? N * N : rows * N);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    if (root) printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    initRows(A, N, rowBegin, rowEnd);\n    initRows(B, N, 0, N);\n\n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    if (root) printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeLocalRows(A, B, C, N, rows, devices);\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    const double localMs = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(end - start).count();\n    double maxMs = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localMs, &maxMs, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(maxMs));\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS\n        double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / (maxMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Gather the full C on root for output and validation\n    if (needFullC) {\n        MPI_Datatype rowType;\n        MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(N), MPI_DOUBLE, &rowType);\n        MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n        std::vector<int> counts(size);\n        std::vector<int> displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            const size_t b = partBegin(r, size, N);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(b);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(partBegin(r + 1, size, N) - b);\n        }\n\n        if (root) {\n            MPI_Gatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, rowType, C.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(),\n                        rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        } else {\n            MPI_Gatherv(C.data(), static_cast<int>(rows), rowType, nullptr, counts.data(),\n                        displs.data(), rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        }\n        MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (root && printResults) {\n        print_results(C, \"MatrixC\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    int valid = 1;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            std::vector<double> fullA(N * N);\n            initRows(fullA, N, 0, N);\n            valid = validateResult(fullA, B, C, N) ? 1 : 0;\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    return valid ? 0 : 1;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    const int rc = runBenchmark(argc, argv);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return rc;\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1521,"cache_read_input_tokens":29347,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1521},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"20161627-4a5a-4145-9385-593c18bc5b3a","uuid":"756bd89d-9e78-46ca-81a2-2d2bb6f1320d","timestamp":"2026-10-13T13:15:18.193Z","request_id":"req_011CfzJ9v2vSZTvfAW3mxdyp"}

k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n\n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, OpenMP threads per rank: %d\\n\", size, omp_get_max_threads());\n    }\n\n    // Bind each rank to GPUs on its node\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    int localSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &localSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n\n    const std::vector<int> devices = selectDevices(localRank, localSize);\n    for (int d : devices) {\n        // Create the CUDA context up front so it stays out of the timed region\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(d));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(0));\n    }\n\n    // This rank's block of rows of A and C\n    const size_t rowBegin = partBegin(rank, size, N);\n    const size_t rowEnd = partBegin(rank + 1, size, N);\n    const size_t rows = rowEnd - rowBegin;\n\n    // Allocate matrices\n    const bool needFullC = printResults || validate;\n    std::vector<double> A(rows * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C((root && needFullC) ? N * N : rows * N);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    if (root) printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    initRows(A, N, rowBegin, rowEnd);\n    initRows(B, N, 0, N);\n\n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    if (root) printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeLocalRows(A, B, C, N, rows, devices);\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    const double localMs = std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(end - start).count();\n    double maxMs = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localMs, &maxMs, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(maxMs));\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS\n        double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / (maxMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Gather the full C on root for output and validation\n    if (needFullC) {\n        MPI_Datatype rowType;\n        MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(N), MPI_DOUBLE, &rowType);\n        MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n        std::vector<int> counts(size);\n        std::vector<int> displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            const size_t b = partBegin(r, size, N);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(b);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(partBegin(r + 1, size, N) - b);\n        }\n\n        if (root) {\n            MPI_Gatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, rowType, C.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(),\n                        rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        } else {\n            MPI_Gatherv(C.data(), static_cast<int>(rows), rowType, nullptr, counts.data(),\n                        displs.data(), rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        }\n        MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (root && printResults) {\n        print_results(C, \"MatrixC\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    int valid = 1;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            std::vector<double> fullA(N * N);\n            initRows(fullA, N, 0, N);\n            valid = validateResult(fullA, B, C, N) ? 1 : 0;\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    return valid ? 0 : 1;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    const int rc = runBenchmark(argc, argv);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return rc;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":45,"oldLines":8,"newStart":45,"newLines":7,"lines":[" // Initialize rows [rowBegin, rowEnd) of an N-column matrix; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzKdJEXugsHhzB7pKpZq","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The matmul benchmark now runs on MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA together, with no fallback path. It builds, and all rank-count configurations I tested validate and produce identical hashes. The only files changed are `matmul/matmul.cpp` and `matmul/CMakeLists.txt`. The executable is still `matmul`, and I built in `/tmp` so the repo has no build artifacts.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI:** C is split into block rows, with each rank's share proportional to its GPU count. Each rank holds its A rows and a full B. Ranks gather C to rank 0 only when `-r` or `-v` needs it. Timing starts after a barrier and reports the max across ranks.\n- **CUDA:** each rank binds to its node-local GPUs (round-robin when ranks outnumber GPUs). The kernel is tiled and register-blocked, and walks k in increasing order so each element accumulates in the same order as the original.\n- **OpenMP:** one host thread drives each GPU, and OpenMP also parallelizes matrix initialization.\n- **CMake:** `project` now includes CUDA, and MPI, OpenMP, and CUDAToolkit are `REQUIRED`. The default architectures are 75/80/86/90, overridable with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES`. The `.cpp` is compiled as CUDA, so no new files were needed.\n\n**Verification (3× RTX 3090, single node)**\n- Ranks 1–4 (including more ranks than GPUs) with `-v -r`: all validate, and every rank count gives the same hash as the single-rank run.\n- N=2048 and N=512 reproduce the original binary's hash exactly.\n- N=5, 100, 1000 differ from the original by about 1 ulp. The fused multiply-add (FMA) rounds differently there. The original's own FMA contraction varies by element, so I couldn't match it bit-for-bit everywhere. I kept FMA because it is about 1.8× faster in the kernel. Relative differences are about 1e-16.\n- N=4096: about 1.1–1.4 TFLOPS aggregate. I did not time the original at this size, so I have no speedup figure.\n\n**Choices to review**\n- The program now prints one extra line, `MPI ranks: X, OpenMP threads per rank: Y`, which changes stdout.\n- The build uses `g++-12` as nvcc's host compiler, because CUDA 12.0 doesn't support GCC 13.\n- I tested only one node. Multi-node runs and the validation-failure exit path were not exercised."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1539,"cache_read_input_tokens":77628,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1539},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"20161627-4a5a-4145-9385-593c18bc5b3a","uuid":"0ead0a71-406f-492d-a566-595ec8222e43","timestamp":"2026-10-13T13:33:41.930Z","request_id":"req_011CfzKdFanCpC3kZQ6g3tuM"}

The fused multiply-add (FMA) rounds differently there. The original's own FMA contraction varies by element, so I couldn't match it bit-for-bit everywhere.
